The '''Viper 40 ion engine''' was a type of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] made by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. A pair of these engines were installed on the [[Koqus liner]] ''[[Star Morning]]'', though the engines were adequate for ship with a keel mass half again greater.<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>
